summary: Targeted verification of responsive hero fix using CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride across 4 viewports. All acceptance criteria PASSED. Stats row (fade-up-delay-4) fully visible above the fold on 1440x900, 1600x900, 1366x768, and 1920x1080. Headline font-size correctly compacts to 68px on 900px-tall viewports, 58px on 768px-tall viewport, and remains premium 92px on 1080px desktop. All 3 stat blocks (EST. EXPERIENCE 25+ years, VENTURES LIVE 02, OUTCOME Commercial) visible. All page sections load. Empty enquiry form submit still shows sonner toast 'Please complete the required fields.'. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero fix is well-scoped: uses max-height media queries (@920px, @800px) targeting only the hero section via [data-testid] selectors, so no leakage to other sections.
Uses !important to override Tailwind utilities inside the responsive block - acceptable trade-off for targeted overrides.
Desktop >= 1080px height is untouched (92px headline preserved) - matches design intent.
Minor: The footer testid is 'site-footer' not 'footer-section'. Consider standardising naming, but not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified viewports via CDP session (page.context.new_cdp_session). Playwright's set_viewport_size does NOT change window.innerHeight in this env - must use Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride. Measured: 1440x900 statsBottom=852 (font 68px), 1600x900 statsBottom=852 (font 68px), 1366x768 statsBottom=732 (font 58px), 1920x1080 statsBottom=1024 (font 92px). All under viewport height. Sonner toast still working for empty enquiry submit.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - verification test, no bug found. Original bug: on <=920px-tall laptop viewports, the stats row of the hero was pushed below the fold due to Tailwind classes (2xl:pt-28, 2xl:mt-14, text-[92px] headline) applied at larger widths without regard to short height. Fix uses CSS @media (max-height: 920px) / (max-height: 800px) rules keyed on [data-testid=hero-section] to compact top/bottom padding, headline font-size, and inter-block margins so the row stays above the fold. Verified visually and via getBoundingClientRect on all 4 target viewports.
